title: allcountypaving.com
description: South Florida, asphalt, parking lots, striping — an unremarkable, seemingly dull business. The company whose legal name is M&M Asphalt Maintenance, Inc., operating under the trade name All County Paving (and in parallel through All National Services LLC dba All County Paving National), is based at 1180 SW 10th Street, Delray Beach, FL 33444. Licensed contractor #U-19887, member of professional associations ICSC, CAI, SEFAA, IREM, CREW, AAGO, and BBB — on the surface, a textbook example of a mid-sized construction company.
